senses.gloss: f.(b. h. סַנְסִנִּים pl.; v. ) [prick,] the pointed ribbed leaf of the palm tree.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 93a:7">Snh. 93ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 7:9">Cant. VII, 9</cite>) <he>לא עלתה בידי אלא ס׳ אחת</he> (v. Rashi) I can claim as mine only one leaf (of the palm Israel) that of Hanania &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 992:43">Yalk. Cant. 992</cite> <cite ref="O01250"><he>סַנְסִנָּה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>סַנְסִנִּים</he>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:14">Num. R. s. 3</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:10">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 845:3">Yalk. Ps. 845</cite> <he>ס׳ לכברה</he> (not <he>לכבד</he>) the leaves (of the palm tree) are used for sieves.
